Rashi on Megillah 15a:10:1.english: And she was exceedingly distressed [vatitchalchal] - the cavity of her body dissolved:

Rashi on Megillah 15a:11:1.hebrew: שחתכוהו מגדולתו - בימי אחשורוש, שהרי בלשצר השליטו תלתא במלכותו, וכן דריוש המדי, שנאמר: "ועלה מנהון סרכיא תלתא די דניאל חד מנהון" (דניאל ו), וכן כורש, שנאמר: "ודניאל הצלח במלכות דריוש ובמלכות כורש פרסאה" (שם), וכשמלך אחשורוש חתכו מגדולתו:
Rashi on Megillah 15a:11:1.english: Because he was cut down from his greatness - [This occurred] in the days of Ahasuerus, for Belshazzar appointed him third [ruler] in his kingdom, and similarly Darius the Mede, as it is stated: "And over them three presidents, of whom Daniel was one" (Daniel 6), and similarly Cyrus, as it is stated: "And Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian" (ibid.), and when Ahasuerus became king, he cut him down from his greatness.

Rashi on Megillah 15a:13:1.english: But he - Daniel did not go to bring back his message:

Rashi on Megillah 15a:13:2.hebrew: על הקלקלה - שהיתה אסתר מונעת לבא אל המלך, לפיכך לא השיב התך את שליחותו, ואסתר שלחה דבריה ע"י אחרים:
Rashi on Megillah 15a:13:2.english: Regarding a sad report - [Namely,] that Esther was refraining from coming to the king; therefore, Hathach did not report back [on] his mission, and Esther sent her words through others:

Rashi on Megillah 15a:14:1.english: Until now - I had relations under compulsion:

Rashi on Megillah 15a:14:2.english: And now - From now on, [it is] of my [own] will:

Rashi on Megillah 15a:14:3.hebrew: אבדתי ממך - ואסורה אני לך, דאשת ישראל שנאנסה מותרת לבעלה, וברצון אסורה לבעלה:
Rashi on Megillah 15a:14:3.english: I am lost to you - and I am forbidden to you, for the wife of an Israelite who was coerced is permitted to her husband, whereas [one who submits] willingly is forbidden to her husband:

Rashi on Megillah 15a:15:1.hebrew: יו"ט ראשון של פסח - שהרי בי"ג בניסן נכתבו האגרות וניתן הדת בשושן, וי"ד וחמשה עשר וששה עשר התענו, ובששה עשר נתלה המן בערב:
Rashi on Megillah 15a:15:1.english: The first festival day of Passover - For on the thirteenth of Nisan the letters were written and the decree was issued in Shushan, and [on] the fourteenth, fifteenth, and sixteenth they fasted, and on the sixteenth Haman was hanged in the evening:

Rashi on Megillah 15a:15:2.english: That he crossed over a stream of water - to gather the Jews who [were] on the other side:

Rashi on Megillah 15a:19:1.hebrew: שופת את הקדרה - מושיבה על הכירה, היא קרויה שפיתה:
Rashi on Megillah 15a:19:1.english: Places the pot - Placing it on the stove, [this] is called shefitah:

Rashi on Megillah 15a:1:1.hebrew: בשלמא - ירמיה וחנמאל, דכתיב: "ויבא אלי חנמאל בן דודי כדבר ה'" (ירמיהו ל״ב:ח׳). ברוך ושריה — מצינו שהיו תלמידי ירמיה: ברוך, דכתיב: "מפיו יקרא אלי את הדברים האלה ואני כותב על הספר בדיו" (ירמיהו ל״ו:י״ח-י״ט); ושריה — בתוך ספר ירמיה (נא): "הדבר אשר צוה ירמיה את שריה בן מחסיה וגו'". ומצינו בתלמידי נביאים שהיו נביאים: "נחה רוח אליהו על אלישע", ויהושע תלמיד משה. ולקמן תניא בברייתא: ברוך בן נריה ושריה בן מחסיה ודניאל ומרדכי וחגי זכריה ומלאכי — כולן נתנבאו בשנת שתיים לדריוש:
Rashi on Megillah 15a:1:1.english: Granted - [With regard to] Jeremiah and Hanamel, [they are explicit,] as it is written: "And Hanamel my uncle's son came to me according to the word of the Lord" (Jeremiah 32:8). [As for] Baruch and Seraiah — we find that they were disciples of Jeremiah: Baruch, as it is written: "He dictated all these words to me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book" (Jeremiah 36:18–19); and Seraiah — in the Book of Jeremiah (51): "The word that Jeremiah commanded Seraiah the son of Mahseiah, etc." And we find regarding disciples of prophets that they [too] were prophets: "The spirit of Elijah rests upon Elisha," and Joshua [was] the disciple of Moses. And later it is taught in a baraita: Baruch son of Neriah, and Seraiah son of Mahseiah, and Daniel, and Mordecai, and Haggai, Zechariah, and Malachi — all of them prophesied in the second year of Darius:

Rashi on Megillah 15a:22:1.hebrew: וזה בא בפרוזבולי - מרדכי בא אליו בטענת עושר, המן בא בטענת עוני, שמכר המן את עצמו למרדכי קודם לכן ימים רבים בככרי לחם:
Rashi on Megillah 15a:22:1.english: And this one came as a rich man [bifrozbuli] - Mordecai came to him with a claim of wealth, [whereas] Haman came with a claim of poverty, for Haman had sold himself to Mordecai many days earlier for loaves of bread:

Rashi on Megillah 15a:22:2.hebrew: בולי - לשון עושר, כדאמרינן (גיטין דף לז.): "ושברתי את גאון עוזכם" — אלו בולאות שביהודה:
Rashi on Megillah 15a:22:2.english: Buli - [This is] an expression of wealth, as we say (Gittin 37a): "And I will break the pride of your power" [Leviticus 26:19] — these are the bula'ot [wealthy notables] in Judea:

Rashi on Megillah 15a:3:1.english: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah - he [is the one] who killed Gedaliahu the son of Achikam, the righteous [man]:

Rashi on Megillah 15a:4:1.hebrew: בשנת שתים לדריוש - האחרון, נתנבאו לבני הגולה שיחזרו לבית המקדש, שנתבטלה המלאכה זה שמונה עשרה שנה על ידי שמרונים, משהתחילו בה בימי כורש:
Rashi on Megillah 15a:4:1.english: In the second year of Darius - [meaning Darius] the last, they prophesied to the exiles that they should return to [rebuild] the Temple, [as] the work had been halted for eighteen years by the Samaritans, from when they had begun it in the days of Cyrus:

Rashi on Megillah 15a:5:1.hebrew: בגדה יהודה - סיפיה דקרא, "ובעל בת אל נכר":
Rashi on Megillah 15a:5:1.english: Judah has dealt treacherously - The end of the verse [reads], "and has married the daughter of a strange god":

Rashi on Megillah 15a:8:1.english: By her name she aroused lust - One who mentions her name is drawn after lustful desire:

Rashi on Megillah 15a:9:1.hebrew: ה"ג מאי אמר - כשצעק צעקה גדולה ומרה, מה היה אומר בצעקתו:
Rashi on Megillah 15a:9:1.english: The text reads: What did he say - When [Mordechai] cried out with a loud and bitter cry, what was he saying in his cry?

Rashi on Megillah 15a:9:2.english: Rav said - This is what [Mordecai] was crying out:

Rashi on Megillah 15a:9:3.english: Haman has risen above Ahasuerus - For his heart emboldened him to speak of something that had not entered Ahasuerus's mind.

Rashi on Megillah 15a:9:4.english: The upper King has prevailed - It is a euphemism for the opposite, [phrased] in clean language.

Tosafot on Megillah 15a:14:1.hebrew: כשם שאבדתי מבית אבא כך אבדתי ממך - וא"ת: אמאי לא היה מגרשה, ותהא מותרת להחזירנה? י"ל: לפי שכל מעשה הגט הוא ע"פ עדים, והיה ירא פן יתפרסם הדבר למלכות:
Tosafot on Megillah 15a:14:1.english: Just as I was lost to my father's house, so too, I am lost to you - And if you ask: Why did [Mordecai] not divorce her, so that she would be permitted [for him] to take her back? One can answer: Because the entire procedure of [giving] a bill of divorce is [performed] before witnesses, and he was afraid lest the matter become known to the monarchy:

Tosafot on Megillah 15a:16:1.hebrew: ביום השלישי - בזכות תורה, נביאים וכתובים; א"נ כהנים, לוים וישראלים; אי נמי משה, ואהרן ומרים; אי נמי שלישי דמתן תורה:
Tosafot on Megillah 15a:16:1.english: On the third day - In the merit of the Torah, Prophets, and Writings; alternatively, Priests, Levites, and Israelites; alternatively, Moses, Aaron, and Miriam; alternatively, [the] third [day] of the giving of the Torah:

Tosafot on Megillah 15a:7:1.hebrew: ארבע נשים יפיפיות היו בעולם - קשה: אמאי לא חשיב חוה? דהא אמרינן בפ' חזקת הבתים (ב"ב דף נח.): שרה לפני חוה כקוף בפני אדם! ויש לומר, דלא חשיב אלא אותן הנולדות מאשה:
Tosafot on Megillah 15a:7:1.english: There were four women of extraordinary beauty in the world - It is difficult: why does [the baraita] not count Eve? For we say in the chapter [entitled] Chezkat HaBatim (Bava Batra 58a): Sarah compared to Eve is like a monkey compared to a human! And one can say that [the baraita] only counts those born of a woman:
